column1: # responsive.governance.tsv — measured 768/375 behaviour for the `governance` section.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, AND WHY IT IS NOT vverify.governance.tsv
# Section `governance` has 125 desktop Figma frames and ZERO at 768 or 375. There is
# no tablet/mobile frame to compare against, so these verdicts are NOT Figma-fidelity
# verdicts and MUST NOT be fed to apply-verify.mjs — that pipeline downgrades `done`
# to `partial` on a non-`match` verdict, which would be wrong here. Nothing in this
# file is a Figma comparison. Every verdict is a live render measurement.
# This file is deliberately wired to NO pipeline. It is read by humans.
# METHOD (state it, because a render outranks a code read)
# All rows measured by rendering PRODUCTION app.skai.trade in a real browser at
# 375x900 and 768x900, signed in, then reading getBoundingClientRect / scrollWidth /
# clientWidth and probing scrollability. Explorer routes carry no auth gate and were
# also confirmed to render anonymously. Every figure below is a measured px value,
# not an inference from a class string. Where a fixed width or a wide table LOOKED
# like a defect but measured clean, the row says so — five such candidates were
# cleared by a previous pass and are not re-litigated here.
# COLUMNS
#   row      line number in status.governance.tsv
#   node     Figma node id or section label from that row
#   route    route rendered (cite the route, never App.tsx line — 8 of 8 line refs
#            in status.governance.tsv are stale; all 13 routes still exist)
#   v375     verdict at 375  (verified-good | clipped-<px> | degraded | not-reached)
#   v768     verdict at 768
#   evidence measured numbers
# PROVENANCE, AND THE ONE WAY THESE NUMBERS GO STALE
# Every figure here was read from DEPLOYED production, not from the working tree.
# That is what makes them trustworthy about what users actually get, and it is also
# the one way they expire: a fix that has landed in source but not shipped will still
# measure broken here, and a surface that has been rewritten in source is described
# in its OLD shape. That already happened once during this lane — commit 53e434951
# rewrote the proposals list after these measurements were taken, so rows 50 and 51
# are marked `superseded` rather than silently left to read as current. Before acting
# on any row below, check whether the file it names has moved since this deploy.
# THRESHOLD. `hidden` = viewport scrollWidth minus clientWidth on the box that owns
# the page content. hidden <= 8px is inside the scrollbar-gutter/rounding band and is
# recorded as verified-good. Anything above it is content that a user cannot reach.
# ROOT CAUSE 1 — the Explorer's own overflow-x-auto wrappers are INERT.
# modules/skai-ui/src/components/layout/scroll-area.tsx:5-21 mounts <ScrollBar/> with
# no orientation, so only a VERTICAL scrollbar exists. Radix therefore renders the
# viewport with inline `overflow: hidden scroll` (overflow-x: hidden, measured) and
# gives the viewport's content wrapper the inline style `min-width: 100%; display:
# table;` (measured). `display: table` shrink-wraps to max-content, so every
# `overflow-x-auto` inside the explorer contributes its FULL max-content width to the
# page instead of scrolling — and the excess is then clipped by the hidden viewport,
# with no way to scroll to it. ExplorerLayout.tsx:134 is the single mount point.
# PROVEN BY MUTATION, not by reading: on /explorer/lending at 375, flipping that
# wrapper from display:table to display:block dropped the viewport scrollWidth from
# 976 to 367 and turned the Markets table's overflow-x-auto from
# {scrollWidth 862, clientWidth 862, scrolls:false} into
# {scrollWidth 862, clientWidth 253, scrolls:true}.
# The inline style means a Tailwind class cannot override it without !important.
# NOT FIXED HERE — this is @skai/ui, outside this lane. Reported, not touched.
# ROOT CAUSE 2 — at exactly 768 the explorer sidebar and the desktop table layouts
# switch on together, and the sidebar shrinks the box the tables just widened into.
# ExplorerNav is `hidden md:flex md:flex-col w-56 shrink-0` = 224px measured, and
# matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)') is true at 768. So the content box is 536px while
# every md: rule was authored for a 768px box. This is why /explorer/addresses is
# clean at 375 (mobile layout, 0px hidden) and BROKEN at 768 (157px hidden) — the
# narrower viewport is the one that works.
# ROOT CAUSE 3 — src/pages/defi/Governance.tsx:537-556. The 4-tab sub-nav is
# `<div className="flex justify-center"><TabsList className="inline-flex h-10 ...">`
# with four TabsTrigger at px-6. No overflow-x-auto, no flex-wrap, no responsive
# prefix anywhere in the block. Measured 534px wide inside a 325px slot.
# DESKTOP IS UNAFFECTED. At 1440 every explorer route measured hidden = 0
# (/explorer, /lending, /txs, /defi, /address/:a all 1208/1208). The `done` verdicts
# in status.governance.tsv are about desktop and they still stand. Nothing below
# asks for a redesign of a desktop layout that works.
